title: Cyber and Data Sciences
gist: RAND's Cyber and Data Sciences topic index page lists recent AI, US-China technology and data-center research rather than an article. Items include a technology-diffusion comparison of the US and China, AI loss-of-control exercises and AI data center siting on federal land.

insights.claim: RAND frames the U.S.-China tech rivalry as hinging not only on innovation but on diffusion, meaning each country's capacity to convert technological progress into sustained economic productivity gains.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: Watch diffusion capacity, not just frontier R&D, when judging relative US and China tech strength.
insights.locator: Assessing Chinese and U.S. Technology Diffusion Capacity

insights.claim: A RAND report on digital networks identifies nine factors shaping U.S.-China competition in global digital infrastructure markets and offers five strategic priorities for the United States.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: Digital infrastructure is a contested geopolitical arena; watch network-equipment and cloud market share abroad.

insights.claim: RAND ran a sequence of 'Day After AGI' tabletop exercises on AI loss of control, examining the potential collapse of social legitimacy, economic stability and technical control.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: Signals policy-world attention to AI loss-of-control scenarios and likely regulatory pressure.
insights.locator: Infinite Potential - Insights On Artificial Intelligence Loss of Control

insights.claim: RAND's biosecurity work asks how to harness AI for science and medicine while ensuring it never helps anyone build a biological weapon.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: AI biosecurity safeguards are a likely focus of future regulation of frontier models.
insights.locator: Biosecurity in the Age of AI: Q&A with Steph Guerra

insights.claim: The U.S. government is opening federal land for data center development, and a RAND report explores how siting and construction could be facilitated within energy constraints.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: Federal-land data center siting is a potential unlock for AI capacity; energy supply is the binding constraint to monitor.
insights.locator: AI Data Center Siting on Federal Lands: An Energy View

insights.claim: RAND Europe identifies UK-Netherlands AI collaboration opportunities in life sciences, compute and agrifood, pairing UK commercial scale and research depth with Dutch clinical integration and deployment strengths.
insights.speaker: RAND Corporation
insights.so_what: Minor signal of European bilateral AI sector alliances in health and agritech.
insights.locator: Mapping AI ecosystems in the Netherlands and the UK
